title: Finance-near-extremal run structure plus exact floor cells empties a surviving (L,o) in E_run(10^6)
statement: Leftover surplus theta(L)=3^o/2^L-1 forces every CycleMin word of a surviving pair, in particular L=25781 or L=55293, into a structurally near-extremal OOE/OE class, and exact floor-cell closure then rules that class out.
counterexamples: At n=10^6+1 the packed-to-theta ratio is 23.12 at L=25781 and 1.012 at L=55293. Deepening every OE into OOOE still leaves packed > theta at both lengths. Losing a cheap valley costs ~8.62e-8, so 6532 of 6751 cheap OOE may rise at L=25781 and 177 of 14479 at L=55293

The residual lose-class has log10 binom(14479,177)>200 at L=55293 and log10 binom(6751,6532)>300 at L=25781. Conditioning on finance is not a stronger structural statement than the existing OOE/OE packing
The run-type n-window is [10^6+1, 19010076] at L=25781 and [10^6+1, 1011446] at L=55293. The itinerary-independent hull on both windows meets the start and reduces to T <= n^{P_L}
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / exact floor closure
notes: Deviation costs are too small to force near-extremality. Exact closure on the finance-restricted n-window is the existing envelope. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: L=25781 and L=55293 at n=10^6+1; run-type n_max raw crossing; legal OO start 1000053 for landing geometry
